title: Approve the audio direction (warm acoustic-toy sound)
question: The audio direction one-pager is drafted and waiting on you. The identity it proposes: warm, acoustic, toy-like — real recorded sounds over synthesis wherever a sound is 'voiced' or a reward, synthesis kept for ticks and impacts. The delegation arc gets scored: as machines take over the work, the music takes over the labor sounds. It ends with three taste questions only you can answer.
why_now: Your own foley recording session (the watering can, the harvest sounds) waits on this — recordings should target a decided aesthetic, not precede one. Approving unblocks that chain.

options.label: Approve as drafted
options.detail: Lock the direction; the foley session and any music commissioning proceed against it.

options.label: Approve with amendments
options.detail: Write what to change in the judgment box; the doc gets revised and this closes.

options.label: Not yet — discuss first
options.detail: Say what's unresolved and it becomes a working session.
